articles.title: Nvidia-led tech selloff weighs on crypto majors
articles.snippet: Only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market value are up 1% or more over the past 24 hours. That is the state of the market today.

articles.title: Coinbase gets full U.S. trust charter from federal banking regulator
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency elevated the biggest U.S. exchange's trust status from conditional to a full-fledged charter, the company said.

articles.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
articles.snippet: A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

articles.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
articles.snippet: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.
